messages:
omar-l: Hey payroll team — I moved from NY -> TX (home base) on 2026-11-10 but did a 2-week client onsite in NJ in Nov. My 11/30 paycheck shows NY state withholding for the entire month. Can payroll check whether we should reallocate state wages and how this will show on my W-2?

jen-people-ops: @omar-l thanks for the note. Please confirm emp ID and last4 SSN and attach proof of move if you have it. @samir-payroll tagging you. :wave:

omar-l: Emp ID `54211`, last4 `1122`. Uploaded lease move-in and TX driver license scan to ticket.

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2026-802: "NY->TX midyear relocation + NJ client onsite (state allocation) - Omar L (54211)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Thanks. Short answer: TX has no income tax so any TX days shouldn't have withholding; NY withholding applies while you were NY resident or working in NY. NJ withholding may apply for onsite client work. We classify wages by work dates in the payroll ledger (not pay date).

keisha-mgr: Confirming Omar was remote TX-based after 11/10 and the NJ onsite was 11/16-11/29. I added manager attestation to the ticket.

samir-payroll: Action plan: 1) pull ledger lines for Nov pay period, 2) allocate earnings to NY (days through 11/10), TX (days 11/11-11/15 and 11/30+), NJ (onsite days 11/16-11/29), 3) compute net withholding per state and propose correction approach (adjust future withholdings or issue refund / documentation). If final reporting changes, we'll show multiple state entries on W-2 boxes 15-17.

omar-l: Can you show an example of how the W-2 might look? My CPA asked.

samir-payroll: Example (illustrative only):

Box 15: NY    2026   7200.00
Box 15: NJ    2026   4400.00
Box 15: TX    2026   0.00
Box 16: NY wages   7200.00
Box 16: NJ wages   4400.00
Box 17: NY tax     320.00
Box 17: NJ tax     190.00

samir-payroll: We'll post the actual numbers to PR-2026-802 after ledger extraction. If we discover NY withholding was applied to TX or NJ wages by mistake, we'll recommend either: a) payroll offset on upcoming runs, b) refund per payroll policy, or c) W-2c if reporting boxes need correction.

jen-people-ops: Thanks all. Omar — we'll follow up in the ticket within 5 business days. Closing Slack thread for tracking; will update here once resolved. :white_check_mark:
